Khaleel Ahmed to Jansen, FOUR runs 
Inside edged for four and PBKS win! Length ball angled across, Jansen looks to pull 
and gets it past the stumps and Dhoni! CSK are officially out of contention for the 
playoff race. Punjab Kings, though, are back in the top four with a hard-fought win in the 
end! 
11.27pm A stunning knock from Shreyas Iyer, backed up by Prabhsimran Singh's half-
century have seen Punjab Kings home as CSK slide to their fifth defeat at the Chepauk. 
PBKS go second on the table, one point behind RCB. Yuzvendra Chahal's hat-trick in the 
first innings helped them keep CSK to 190 when 200-plus looked inevitable. Sam 
Curran's blitz goes in vain. We did see some positives for CSK. Apart from Curran's 
knock, there was some stunning fielding from Dewald Brevis, but other than that, their 
wretched campaign continues to be just that. 
MS Dhoni: "I think the batting, yes it was the first time we put enough runs on the board, 
but I feel it was slightly short of a par score. It's demanding on the batsmen but we 
needed slightly more. The partnership between Curran and Brevis was fantastic. I think 
we need to take our catches. I think Curran is a fighter, we all know. Unfortunately 
whenever we have tried to give him a chance so far, it was a slow wicket but today's 
wicket was the best one we had at home this season. [On Brevis] I think it's momentum 
in the middle order and he's a very good fielder and he has good power so he can hit 
good balls for boundaries. He brings energy in the field too. We needed that fresh air, 
someone not caught up in the spiral. He can be an asset going forward." 
Prabhsimran Singh: "[On the opening stand with Priyansh Arya] We both are hitting well 
so sometimes it happens that the wicket looks like it'll play slow so we took our time at 
the start, so when he got out I took the onus of scoring runs. When we had our camps, 
we were told we'll open together so we bonded well from then only and we opened 
together from that time. I wasn't thinking too much about the run rate because I knew 
Shreyas is there, so if I miss out, I knew he'd hit a few boundaries. [On his role and form] 
I always thought that even if I get 35-40 runs in a winning cause it's good, I don't need to 
score 70-80 or 100. And I am just trying to carry on when I get set. I would like to give 
the credit to Ricky Ponting. Even when things are going bad if the coach or captain go 
and speak to the players, it really helps. Yes, now we are looking at qualification, and we 
are doing our best to do that." 
Srini: "Yuzi's over made all the difference. CSK were looking at 220 after that massive 
Shedge over." -- Yup, that over made a massive difference! And Arshdeep's as well, right 
after Shedge's over. 
Deepankar DM : "Please tell me there's no crazy mathematical podsibility remaining for 
CSK?" -- Nope, they are officially out of contention. 
Jedi : "So CSK lost 5 games at home for the first time in a IPL season??" -- yes. 
Vallabs: "I feel like Yuzi Chahal deserves the POTM today... not often do you see a hat-
trick in a T20 match" -- changed the game with that hat-trick, so yeah, I'd think so too! 
We'll find out soon. 
Shreyas Iyer is the player of the match. Here's what he has to say: "[On his form and 
knock] I love chasing on any field. I feel like I thrive whenever there is a big total on the 
board and you need to take the charge and momentum for the team for the rest of the 
batters to come and go full throttle. I don't want to curse it [his away form] and just stay 
in the present and reacting to the ball. It doesn't matter where I am playing. I just play 
with my approach. Sometimes it works sometimes it doesn't. Lately I have been battin 
ga lot in the nets and facing the quick bowlers, especially with the new ball and that's 
given me immense confidence. This is one part I have really worked on. And the attitude 
is something that I keep high whenever I approach the field. So I think all these small 
boxes have been ticked and that's there to see. More than batting, the fielding was 
difficult since I was running from long-on to long-on. We had to maintain over rate and I 
had to think at the nick of time. The humidity was more than any other field I've played 
on. [On the chase] We had a chat in between when Ricky came in and said we have to 
up the ante and not leave it to the end as they have great death bowlers. So the 
approach was to just take on the bowlers with the power hitters coming down the order 
and back ourselves. When I got in I said that I need to play a few balls to see how the 
wicket is playing. When I played ten balls then I started going. Prabh and Priyansh have 
been fabulous the way they have been playing. They have been smart, not just 
slogging." 
11.45pm Time for the presentation ceremony. 
Rahul: "KKR might be kicking them selves for picking the wrong Iyer." 
11.50pm Alright then, that's that for today. Karthik Krishnaswamy's report will fill you in 
on all you need to know. Tomorrow, Rajasthan Royal could become the second team to 
get knocked out of playoffs contention if they lose to Mumbai Indians, but they are 
riding on the high of the win powered by their 14-year-old Vaibhav Suryavanshi. How will 
he go against Boult and Bumrah? Join us tomorrow to find out. For now, it's Abhimanyu 
signing off on behalf of Vishal, Vairavan and everyone else at ESPNcricinfo.
